content:
aj: Quick check — anyone know current GPU pool availability for us-west? Need to spin up 3x A100s for a load test next week. @eng-infra
ops-bot: Capacity snapshot @eng-infra: us-west GPU free: 5 A100, 2 V100. Predicted contention on Mon 2026-03-23 09:00-12:00 UTC. See /capacity-dashboard
devon: thanks. Are those dedicated GPUs or shared? If shared, what's preemption/eviction policy?
ops-bot: shared. Eviction priority: spot > preemptible > reserved. Reserved capacity: 2 A100s in us-west (prod).
sam: I can provision 2 reserved A100s immediately; one more would need procurement approval. cc @finance
kyla: FYI procurement lead says approval for extra reserved unit usually 48–72h. For the load test can we fall back to mixed (2 reserved + 1 spot)?
maria: That works. Also please create a ticket and tag infra and finance. I started one: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421 — add test details.
devon: pinging @aj — also note model size: 70B model needs >80GB memory; A100-40 won't fit unless we quantize. Suggest we use A100-80 or split across 2 GPUs with tensor-parallelism.
aj: Good catch. We'll aim for 2x A100-80 reserved + 1 spot as fallback. I'll update INF-3421 with sequence lengths and batch sizes. Thanks.
ops-bot: Noted. Tentative reservation hold: 48h. Run `gcloud compute quota list --project=redwood-prod` to check cloud quotas. :robot_face:
